cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Lose Something for Me
cards.instruction: Create a loyalty test by asking them to accept a real disadvantage on your behalf.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've kept you the front-row seat for my opening. Send the prize organizers your apologies; I'll expect you here tonight.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm receiving the prize. I'd miss hearing my own name.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I know. That's the part that makes this a choice for me. You may tell them I asked you personally; I'll accept your congratulations from that seat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's an unfair test. Could I come to tomorrow's performance instead?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tomorrow is open to everyone. Tonight I've kept your place beside the people I count on. Tell me whether to keep it; I want your answer before you send either set of apologies.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 directs B award apologies and expected attendance; A3 permits naming A request; A5 judges B4 later-performance alternative against A inner-circle seat and demands answer first, using assumed precedence to impose sacrifice.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 missing own prize moment causes A3 explicit meaning of cost; B4 tomorrow proposal causes A5 distinction between ordinary attendance and tonight personal loyalty.

relationship.evidence: B2 states a real achievement loss and B4 offers another showing, a credible caring alternative A deems insufficient.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 costless compromise to make the reserved seat a test of who A can count on, escalating social pressure from invitation to allegiance.

specificity.evidence: A1 opening and reserved seat, B2 prize recipient and B4 next performance make the real disadvantage and alternatives clear.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 is emotionally forceful and slightly long; its apologies order makes authority concrete rather than explaining the card outside dialogue.
